hero.description: Your wealth deserves expert care. With nearly two decades of experience, WealthKare helps you make smarter financial decisions with confidence and trust.

services.subtext: From mutual funds to unlisted equities, we offer every solution your wealth journey needs — all under one trusted roof. Eight services. One relationship.

items.description: Professionally managed, diversified portfolios — built around your goals, reviewed regularly, and distributed through Regular Plans only.
Individually managed equity portfolios for investors with ₹50 lakhs and above — direct ownership, transparent reporting, active strategy.
Institutional-grade alternative strategies — private equity, real estate, and hedge funds — accessible to qualified investors.
Fixed-income instruments from rated issuers — predictable cash flows, capital preservation, and yields that outperform conventional deposits.
Higher-yield fixed deposits from NBFC and corporate issuers — better returns on your fixed-income allocation without equity risk.
Pre-IPO and unlisted equity opportunities — early access to companies before they list, with asymmetric return potential for informed investors.
Protection that complements your wealth — term cover, health insurance, and general insurance structured to safeguard what you've built.
Home, car, and personal loans facilitated through trusted banking and NBFC partners — liquidity solutions when you need them.
